review_notes: Exact finite inventory is limited to disposable VS Code C/C++ index/precompiled-header cache; model/reference/raw/venv/binary are outside roots.
Every current file matches frozen metadata, is uid-owned regular nlink1, and is a recognized .ipch/mmap_address.bin/.browse.VC.db[-wal/-shm/.lock] file.

Plan reports no cpptools process or readable fd/maps reference. Two unreadable same-user maps are disclosed, so universal absence of open mappings is not proven; this alone is not a blocker for disposable cache.
Atomic rename into unique quarantine must precede revalidation and unlink. A concurrently recreated original cache root must be left untouched.
Revalidate exact file and directory inventory after rename; refuse any changed/new/symlink entry, record/fsync journal, unlink only frozen paths and rmdir empty known directories.
Recovery is editor reindexing, not byte restoration. This cache deletion does not promise identical cache inode/mtime/content recovery.
